title: The ALMA Survey of Gas Evolution of PROtoplanetary Disks (AGE-PRO): Formaldehyde (H<SUB>2</SUB>CO) Emission and Its Links to Disk Properties
question: Investigate the emission of H2CO (excitation temperature, column density, and line luminosities) in 20 Class II protoplanetary disks from the Lupus and Upper Sco regions and evaluate how H2CO emission connects to disk and stellar properties.

what.value: Geometric distances of the 20 target stars

evidence.quote: All distances are adopted from geometric distance of (cite: BailerJones2021).

what.value: Line properties (frequencies, Aul, Eu, gu) and partition function Q for H2CO from CDMS

evidence.quote: All values in this table are from the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (cite: ENDRES201695).
The partition function Q is interpolated using values from the CDMS catalog (cite: MULLER2001; MULLER2005215; ENDRES201695).

what.value: H2CO line fluxes for Lupus disks, Keplerian mask parameters for Lupus, dust disk masses, and CO/13CO/C18O line luminosities

evidence.quote: We take line fluxes for the Lupus disks from (cite: Deng_Lupus), and calculate the line fluxes for Upper Sco following the same methodology.
We also test correlations between the H$_2$CO line luminosity and the CO, $^{13}$CO, and C$^{18}$O $J$=2-1 line luminosities from (cite: Deng_Lupus; AGE-PRO_IV_UpperSco).

what.value: Inclination and position angles from 1.3 mm continuum emission, dust disk radii Rdust, and dust substructures

evidence.quote: For the Upper Sco sources, we generate Keplerian masks based on the inclination and position angles measured from 1.3 mm continuum emission by (cite: ageproX).
The dust disk radius, $R_{\text{dust}}$, is the radius at which 90$\%$ of the 1.3 mm continuum flux is enclosed (taken from (cite: ageproX)).

evidence.quote: we examine how its line luminosity relates to the following key system properties: gas disk radius, dust disk radius, gas disk mass (cite: ageproV), dust disk mass (cite: Deng_Lupus; AGE-PRO_IV_UpperSco), stellar mass (cite: AGEPRO_I_overview), stellar luminosity (cite: AGEPRO_I_overview), and CO abundance (cite: ageproV).

evidence.quote: The gas disk radius, $R_{\text{gas}}$, is the radius at which 90$\%$ of the CO gas emission is enclosed (taken from (cite: ageproXI)).

evidence.quote: We also test correlations between the H$_2$CO line luminosity and the CO, $^{13}$CO, and C$^{18}$O $J$=2-1 line luminosities from (cite: Deng_Lupus; AGE-PRO_IV_UpperSco).
The incl, PA, and distance for the Upper Sco sources were obtained from (cite: Deng_Lupus) for the Lupus sources and from (cite: AGE-PRO_IV_UpperSco) for the Upper Sco sources

evidence.quote: We use the line luminosities from the 9 detections from the Lupus and Upper Sco disks in this work, as well as 13 disks from the literature (cite: Pegues20), leading to a total sample of 22 disks.
we include the H$_2$CO upper limits for remaining AGE-PRO disks and from two additional disks in (cite: Pegues20) that only have upper limits for the H$_2$CO p-3-2 line.

recipe.goal: Generate moment-zero maps using Keplerian masking
recipe.method: Apply Keplerian masks to channel maps to create moment-zero maps; for Upper Sco, inclination and PA are from 1.3 mm continuum, v_sys from eddy, and mask adjustments evaluated by eye on channel maps (using 12CO J=2-1 for non-detections).
key_parameters: PA, incl, M_star, Dist, v_sys, and CO Mask Radius per disk as listed in Table 3; velocity ranges in Table [tab:flux]

recipe.goal: Measure integrated line fluxes, upper limits, and R90 radii via curve-of-growth
recipe.method: Project elliptical apertures onto moment-zero maps using continuum inclination and PA; integrate total flux within R100 (first maximum of integrated flux curve) and determine R90 (radius enclosing 90% of total cumulative flux).
key_parameters: R100 determined independently for Band 6 and Band 7; 3-sigma detection threshold requiring both 3-sigma line flux and visible channel map emission

recipe.method: Deproject image coordinates to disk-plane coordinates and compute azimuthally averaged radial profiles and standard-deviation uncertainties within each radial bin using GoFish radial_profile().
key_parameters: bin width dr = 4 x pixel size (pixel size 0.025" for Band 6, 0.04" for Band 7); r_min = 0; r_max = 5 x R_max (CO Mask Radius in Table 3)
assumptions: Disk inclination and position angle from continuum emission (Table 3)

recipe.goal: Derive excitation temperature, total column density, and optical depth via rotational diagram
recipe.method: Iteratively solve rotational diagram equations with optical depth correction C_tau using Taylor expansion of tau_ul and MCMC linear fitting; for single-line detections, fix T_ex at 10 K and 40 K to compute column density range.
key_parameters: Solid angle Omega from R90 radius; convergence threshold < 0.001% or max 5000 iterations; 4 MCMC walkers, 5000 steps, burn-in 100 steps, thinning every 15th step; 5000 Monte Carlo draws for tau_ul error
assumptions: Local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE), nuclear spin-weights of 3:1 for ortho:para H2CO in CDMS partition function

recipe.goal: Evaluate correlations between H2CO properties and disk/stellar parameters
recipe.method: Use Bayesian linear regression (linmix) to test correlations involving H2CO line luminosities (accounting for upper limits) and Monte-Carlo Spearman-rho tests (scipy.stats.spearmanr) for T_ex, N_tot, and R90 using detections only.
key_parameters: linmix: K = 2 Gaussians, 5,000 to 100,000 MCMC steps, positive correlation if r > 0.3 (very strong if r > 0.7); Spearman-rho: 10,000 Monte Carlo iterations, alternative='greater', significant if p-value < 0.05
assumptions: For single-line detections, the average of column densities at 10 K and 40 K is used in correlation tests; input parameters in Spearman test follow normal distributions around observed values.

answer_key.quantity: Overall H2CO detection rate in AGE-PRO sample

evidence.quote: Within this sample we achieve a detection rate of H$_2$CO of 45% (9/20), and set robust upper limits for the non-detections.

answer_key.quantity: H2CO p-3-2 detection rate in Lupus

evidence.quote: This means that we recover a detection rate for the p-3-2 line of 20% for Lupus and 50% for Upper Sco, and a detection rate for the p-4-3 line of 30% in Lupus and and 40% in Upper Sco.

score_reason: Downstream analysis (Keplerian mask parameters, velocity ranges, fluxes, R90 radii, rotational diagram equations, MCMC settings, and full correlation input tables) is thoroughly documented and tabulated, but raw data calibration/imaging is entirely delegated to companion papers and a few parameters (line width Delta nu in tau equation, R100 values, exact H2CO mask radius adjustments) are not explicitly listed.
rediscovery_reason: The ALMA Large Program data (2021.1.00128.L) are public in the archive, all target coordinates, mask parameters, and downstream statistical tables are provided in the paper, and the main results (line fluxes, R90, T_ex, N_tot, and correlation coefficients) are concrete numeric values.
